My plot is small, only about a quarter of an acre, and beans do not need much like maize does. I will put some manure from my goats because I have it at home and it costs me nothing, but fertilizer from the shop is too expensive for such a small bean plot — last year I did the same and the harvest was enough for the family. I will use seed I saved from last season because the agro-dealer seed is costly and my own seed has been working. The rains here in Morogoro come well enough, so I do not need to irrigate, and me and my wife can handle the weeding and harvest ourselves.
